# SP-2-202 — Internal Pilot Feedback Rubric

**Sprint:** Sprint 2 (March 25 – April 7, 2026)  
**Issue:** #110  
**Status:** ⏸️ DEFERRED TO SPRINT 3 — Day 8 defer decision executed (all
materials ready, zero rework needed)  
**Predecessor:** SP-2-201-P (Internal Pilot Scope) — ✅ Scope Defined  
**Purpose:** Structured feedback instrument for pilot participants executing the
6-step mini-cycle defined in SP-2-201-P.

---

## Instructions for Pilot Participants

Complete this rubric **immediately after** finishing the mini-cycle. Answer
every section honestly — there are no wrong answers. Your feedback directly
shapes the next sprint's priorities.

**Estimated time:** 15 minutes  
**Format:** Fill in this Markdown file and return it to the Product Manager.

**Severity Levels:**

| **Critical Friction Count** | \_\_\_   | Critical + High severity items          |
